definitions.explanation: A widespread scarcity of food, typically caused by drought, war, or economic collapse, leading to mass hunger and death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旱魃|かんばつ}→旱魃：05122_kanbatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大|だい}→大：noentry⟧{飢饉|ききん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生：03133_hassei⟧。
examples.english: A great famine occurred due to the drought.
Many people lost their lives in the famine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{飢饉|ききん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are still regions in the world suffering from famine.

notes:
HISTORICAL FAMINES IN JAPAN:
・{享保|きょうほう}の{大|だい}{飢饉|ききん} (Kyōhō famine, 1732-1733)
・{天明|てんめい}の{大|だい}{飢饉|ききん} (Tenmei famine, 1782-1788)
・{天保|てんぽう}の{大|だい}{飢饉|ききん} (Tenpō famine, 1833-1839)

KANJI NOTE: {飢|き} (hunger) + {饉|きん} (starving). Both kanji relate to food shortage.

RELATED WORDS:
・{飢餓|きが} (starvation, hunger)
・{凶作|きょうさく} (crop failure)
・{食糧|しょくりょう}{危機|きき} (food crisis)
・{餓死|がし} (death from starvation)

MODERN CONTEXT: Famines continue to occur globally, often due to conflict, climate change, or economic factors.
